title: Post-event gap continuation/reversal Taiwan PIT feasibility audit

eventClock.requirement: Use only event versions available by the replay cutoff; source publication time and capturedAt remain distinct.

openingGap.requirement: Opening gap is a shared primitive. D17-12 receives it as context but cannot count it again as new evidence.

dailyPricePath.source: Validated TWSE MI_INDEX / TPEx dailyQuotes historical A1 family
dailyPricePath.evidence: Requested-date/source-date equality and OHLC integrity already live-validated; prior close, open, high, low, close and eligible subsequent sessions are replayable.
dailyPricePath.use: close and D1/D3/D5 post-event path states

intradayPath.use: first 15m / 30m path only prospectively where exact bars and decision clocks are persisted
intradayPath.historicalLimitation: Do not fabricate historical 15m/30m paths from daily OHLC.

corporateActionFirewall.requirement: Mechanical reference-price resets, unresolved actions and symbol-session continuity breaks => UNKNOWN/BLOCKED.

limitAndSuspension.requirement: Price-limit constrained or halted/resumption paths are separate states, not ordinary continuation/reversal.

replayRules: The opening gap direction/magnitude belongs to the shared event-gap primitive and does not by itself create D17-12 evidence.
D17-12 begins only after the opening observation; additional evidence must come from later price evolution.
Daily historical path may use close and subsequent eligible-session D1/D3/D5 marks from validated official OHLC.
First-15m/30m classification requires exact intraday observations available prospectively; historical daily bars cannot reconstruct them.
Later corrections to event identity/timestamp append a version and cannot rewrite what an earlier replay knew.
Corporate-action, missing-session, halt/resumption and price-limit states fail closed or receive dedicated labels.
Market/sector context may control common movement but cannot become a duplicate D09/D13 directional vote.

antiDoubleCount.D17_12: only the subsequent post-open path transformation
antiDoubleCount.rule: One opening gap is never three independent votes.

falsification: A positive opening gap that reverses by close is not continuation.
A negative gap that recovers to the prior close is not evidence of persistent negative news effect.
A corporate-action reset that mechanically changes reference price is not a news-driven gap path.
A limit-constrained session does not reveal the latent unconstrained continuation/reversal path.
One famous event/date cannot define thresholds; path definitions are frozen before return efficacy tests.

maturityDecision.basis: Validated Taiwan official OHLC, PIT event clocks, corporate-action continuity guards and explicit price-limit/suspension states make causal replay of close and D1/D3/D5 post-event paths feasible. Intraday 15m/30m remains prospective-only. This is source/data feasibility, not evidence that continuation or reversal predicts returns.

exactNext: Build prospective event-cluster cohorts with opening gap as shared context and post-open path as the only D17-12 incremental evidence.
Preregister close/D1/D3/D5 and prospective 15m/30m path definitions before outcome evaluation.
Use market/sector controls and corporate-action/limit-state guards on common support.
Before L4, test whether post-open path adds value beyond D11-10 gap risk and D04-09 tail state.
